message:
Please take a look at this. We keep losing manually renamed task titles after reconnecting to the host. I want the user title to win every time.

This is a reconnect bug, not a request to change the sidebar layout. The task starts with an automatically generated title. I rename it while the connection is healthy. After the host restarts, the sidebar briefly shows my chosen name and then replaces it with an older agent title. The same thing happens after the laptop wakes from sleep, so check both restoration and live summary updates.

Please trace who owns each title value and make the manual rename the source of truth. A delayed response from the title generator must not replace it. If the host is unreachable when I rename a task, keep that edit locally and send it when the host returns. If I undo the rename, restore the prior automatic title rather than inventing a fresh one. Keep names stable when a task is archived and reopened.

Add focused tests for the reconnect race and for a rename made while generation is still pending. Use synthetic tasks and a temporary host store. Do not read personal session data, add a new service, or change the task list design. Keep this change focused on title reconciliation and explain which stale event caused the overwrite.
outcome: Kept user titles during host reconciliation.
